name: Meshobab
title: Descendant of Pahath-Moab
summary: Meshobab is a person mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as one of those who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile. He was the son of Berekiah and participated in the rebuilding work under Nehemiah's leadership. He is one of many faithful Israelites who contributed to the restoration of Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Meshobab is mentioned among those who took part in repairing the wall of Jerusalem after returning from exile in Babylon.

keyEvents.title: The Work Under Nehemiah's Leadership
keyEvents.description: During Nehemiah's organization of the rebuilding work, various families and groups were assigned specific sections of the wall. Meshobab and his fellow workers took part in this important national and spiritual project.

keyEvents.title: Completion of Jerusalem's Restoration
keyEvents.description: The wall around Jerusalem was completed in 52 days, despite opposition from enemies. This stood as a testimony to God's help and the people's unity.

keyEvents.title: The People Renew Their Covenant
keyEvents.description: After the rebuilding of the wall, the people renewed their covenant with God, which was a central event in the period following their return from exile.
